input.title: Give the colour filter select an accessible name that matches its visible label
input.rationale: The select #g-filter has no accessible name. The visible text "Filter by colour" sits in a <label> just before it, but that label has no for attribute and doesn't wrap the select, so the two aren't linked. I can only edit the select itself, so this patch adds aria-label="Filter by colour". It uses the exact visible wording, so screen reader users and voice control users hear and say the same name sighted users see. A better fix in source is to add for="g-filter" to the <label> on line 13. That gives the same name and also lets users click the label to focus the select. If you make that change, remove this aria-label so the name isn't set in two places. I haven't re-run the check after this change.
